szenen.vo: [intense] Look at these two, bro, same dream, same year, and only one tiny difference between them.
[intense] This guy always says he's gonna start on Monday, and then Monday comes and he says it again.
[intense] This guy just starts today, small steps, boring work, every single day, no matter how he feels.
[shouting] December thirty-first! One of them has a whole year of work, and the other one has nothing but excuses!
[intense] And on January first he says this is my year, again! [shouting] Don't be him, bro, start today!
